headline: Norwood Water goes before Norwood Water Commission Work Session on Monday, November 2
blurb: The Norwood Water Commission sits down for a work session focused on a single item: the 2027 draft budget. Work sessions are deliberative — no formal action can be taken — so this is the commission's chance to work through the numbers before anything goes to a vote. The meeting is at Norwood Town Hall on Naturita Street at 6:00 p.m., with a Zoom option available.
